name: gcode-preview
description: Preview a 3d print from a gcode file
author: remcoder@gmail.com

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BUILD,SERVER -c bold.white.bgGreen,bold.white.bgBlue 'npm run dev:watch' 'npm run live-server'
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run live-server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run prettier:fix && npm run eslint:fix
scripts.preversion: npm run typeCheck && npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run copy-deps && npm run copy-dist
scripts.copy-deps: copyfiles -f node_modules/three/build/three.module.min.js demo/lib/three/build && copyfiles -f node_modules/three/build/three.core.min.js demo/lib/three/build && copyfiles -f node_modules/lil-gui/dist/lil-gui.esm.min.js demo/lib/lil-gui/dist
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typeCheck && npm run lint && echo '😅 All checks passed!'
